# Surogate

> Surogate makes four things: Surogate Agents, a platform to design, test,
> govern and run agents for whole teams without writing code; Keel, which runs
> agents inside well-defined processes; the AI Gateway, which puts every model
> behind one API; and custom language and speech models. Agents, Keel and the
> models run in Surogate cloud, on your own Kubernetes or air-gapped; the AI
> Gateway runs on llm.buzz or on your own Kubernetes. Surogate sells direct
> and through partners.

## Pages
- [Home](https://surogate.ai/): Your workforce, multiplied. The four products and where they run.
- [Surogate Agents](https://surogate.ai/agents/): Sessions, sandboxes, tools, skills, knowledge, channels, long-running work, improvement and selling an agent.
- [Keel](https://surogate.ai/keel/): Processes that run agents. Stages, steps, decision rules, approval limits, audit and replay.
- [AI Gateway](https://surogate.ai/gateway/): One endpoint for every model. OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter compatible API, keys and grants per caller, budgets, guardrails, provider failover; hosted on llm.buzz or on your own Kubernetes.
- [Partners](https://surogate.ai/partners/): Build a practice on Surogate. 30% of every client plan and licence, every month; 40% at Diamond.
- [Pricing](https://surogate.ai/pricing/): One plan per client, models at cost, and single-user plans: Free, Standard $19, Pro $96, Max $190 a month.
- [Labs](https://surogate.ai/labs/): Surogate Rune, Surogate Speech and Surogate Engine.
- [Documentation](https://docs.surogate.ai): Agent runtime, hub and developer toolkit.

## Pricing facts
- Pilot: $0 for the first 60 days of every new client.
- Production: $990 a month per client organisation ($940 billed yearly). Up to 1,000 agents working at once.
- Scale: $2,990 a month per client organisation ($2,840 billed yearly). Up to 5,000 agents working at once; single sign-on, roles and audit logs.
- Keel on Surogate cloud: $0.20 per completed case for the first 10,000 a month, $0.10 up to 100,000, $0.05 beyond.
- Models: bring your own provider and pay it directly, or use ours at the provider's price.

## Partners
- Silver: sign up, no fee. Gold: 1 client live, listed in the partner directory. Diamond: 3 clients live, 40% share.
- Become a partner: email surogate@invergent.ai or join the Discord.
